usedFor: Bookingmood sends events like “New Booking” or “Payment Paid”, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers with “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Paid” in Bookingmood, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A paid payment starts a command on your computer, so a local task can run once the money is in.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” acts on your own computers, so check the command is safe to run each time “Bookings Updated” fires.
